page: Microsoft Azure M128-64bds_3_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C x86_64 processor operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz, configured with 32 physical cores and 64 vCPUs. It features an exceptionally high memory allocation of 2794.0 GB, translating to 43.66 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled with a 6144 GB local disk, and the platform is Premium Storage capable. No GPU hardware is present on this instance.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong multi-core processing and memory subsystem performance. It achieved a top-tier rating in large-block read-only memory bandwidth at 367.66 GB/sec, alongside a strong write bandwidth of 169.25 GB/sec. The processor supports advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which facilitate strong performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Geekbench image processing. Single-core performance remains in the average tier, indicating that the architecture is optimized for highly parallelized, memory-bound tasks rather than single-threaded speed.

Given the massive memory-to-CPU ratio and top-tier database operations benchmark score of 35100.58 on Passmark, this server is designed for enterprise-grade database and analytical workloads. It is highly suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, and complex data warehousing. The qualitative cost profile reflects a high-density hardware class where the substantial memory footprint and local storage capacity are balanced against the resource-intensive dedicated CPU allocation.
